jobs.description:
Mechanical Engineer – Oceanbird

Are you a Mechanical Engineer who enjoys turning technical designs into practical solutions? Would you like to contribute to innovative technology that is helping transform the global shipping industry?
Briljantin Consulting is currently looking for a Mechanical Engineer for our client Oceanbird.
Oceanbird is developing innovative wind propulsion technology with the ambition to reduce emissions from commercial shipping. The company is a joint venture between Alfa Laval and Wallenius, combining extensive industrial experience with pioneering engineering solutions.
As a Mechanical Engineer, you will join Oceanbird's Customer Projects team, where you will play an important role in adapting and delivering mechanical solutions for customer-specific installations.
You will be involved throughout the entire project lifecycle, from requirements and mechanical design to manufacturing, installation and commissioning. The role offers a combination of technical engineering, practical problem-solving and collaboration with international customers, suppliers and shipyards.
Your main responsibilities
Develop and adapt mechanical designs for customer-specific projects and installations.

Translate customer and vessel requirements into practical engineering solutions.

Produce and review 3D models, manufacturing drawings, technical specifications, calculations and documentation.

Manage mechanical interfaces between Oceanbird's technology, vessels and shipyard structures.

Participate in design reviews, risk assessments and technical investigations.

Collaborate with suppliers and manufacturing partners regarding quality, cost and delivery.

Provide technical support during installation, commissioning and testing.

Contribute to continuous improvements, standardization and engineering best practices.

Ensure compliance with relevant marine regulations, classification requirements and internal processes.

Key and mandatory skills
We believe you have:

A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering or a related technical field.

Experience in mechanical design, product development or project engineering.

Good knowledge of 3D CAD software and experience producing manufacturing drawings.

Understanding of materials, manufacturing methods, tolerances and mechanical interfaces.

Strong analytical, documentation and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work independently and take responsibility for technical deliverables.

Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

Desired skills
It is considered an advantage if you have experience or knowledge in one or more of the following areas:

Maritime, offshore, heavy machinery or renewable energy industries.

Ship structures, vessel integration or marine installations.

Hydraulic systems, rotating machinery or large mechanical structures.

Marine classification rules and regulatory requirements.

Installation, commissioning and testing of mechanical equipment.

Working with international suppliers, shipyards or customers.

About you
We are looking for a collaborative, structured and solution-oriented engineer with a genuine interest in mechanical engineering and technical development.
You enjoy taking ownership of your work and finding practical solutions to complex engineering challenges. You are comfortable working across different technical disciplines and understand the importance of balancing technical performance with quality, project timelines and cost requirements.
You have strong communication skills and enjoy collaborating with colleagues, customers and external partners.
Above all, you are motivated by seeing your engineering work become part of real-world installations.
Location and travel
The position is based at Oceanbird's office in Flemingsberg, Stockholm.
As the role supports international customer projects, you should be willing and able to travel to shipyards, customer sites and installation locations. Travel frequency and duration will vary depending on project requirements.
Why join Oceanbird?
At Oceanbird, you will have the opportunity to work with pioneering wind propulsion technology that contributes to the decarbonization of the shipping industry.
You will become part of a highly competent and dedicated team, working in an innovative and international environment where engineering expertise, collaboration and practical execution are key.
This is an opportunity to follow technical solutions from initial engineering through installation and operation, while contributing to a more sustainable future for global shipping.
Does this sound like you?
Then we look forward to receiving your application!
For more information about the position, please contact Briljantin Consulting.
We review applications continuously, so please submit your application as soon as possible.
We don't accept applications sent directly via email.

jobs.description:
Are you driven, analytical and eager to make a change and drive development? Join RISE Processum and work on research projects to develop the bio-based processes of the future together with the industry.
RISE is a gathering of forces for the sustainable transition that business, society, and the world need. We work with the solutions that can make a difference here and now, and with the areas of knowledge and techniques that can be crucial tomorrow.
About us At RISE Processum, we are developing the bio-based processes of the future together with the industry. Through chemistry and biotechnology, we seek to maximize resource efficiency and sustainability in the utilization of society's residual streams for new fossil-free products in food, feed, chemicals, materials and fuel. Within our cluster activities, guidance in techno-economic assessment to both large and small companies in the bioeconomy is a crucial step in the development of new sustainable and competitive concepts.
Our projects range from shorter assignments to larger national and international research projects, often in collaboration with colleagues from RISE's various areas of expertise. You will be part of the Innovationssystem group within Processum, consisting of 10 colleagues.
About the role In collaboration with a team of experts in biotechnology, chemistry, process simulations, business development and technoeconomic assessments, you will develop new research and development projects from idea to finished results. You will conduct contract research to support industry in developing roadmaps for expanding or transitioning existing businesses into competitive and sustainable new market offerings. A substantial part of the role involves developing tools and knowledge through publicly funded collaborative projects, as well as contributing to the development of internal TEA activities at RISE.
You will identify customer needs and build strong customer relationships and develop new business opportunities. This includes securing project funding, preparing funding applications, and contributing to sales and contract-based projects.
The location is Örnsköldsvik. We follow a hybrid work model that allows employees to split their working time between the office and their home workspace. The role includes travel in connection with international projects, such as attending project meetings, events, and conferences.
Who are you? To be successful in the role you are analytical, structured and self-driven. You are motivated by developing projects to create value together with colleagues and partners. You are good at building relationships and with your interest in technology from a societal perspective, you identify needs and turn them into action. You have a strong interest in project management and communication of results.
Requirements for the role
• A Master’s degree in Engineering or Natural Sciences, preferably in Biotechnology or Chemistry
• Experience from working in or closely linked to bioeconomy related industries
• Experience in performing value chain analyses at different levels and techno-economic assessment, preferably on biobased processes
• Experience with process simulations tools
• Project management experience within research and development
• You speak and write fluently in Swedish or English
Are we a good match? At Processum, you will work close to one of Europe’s leading technology infrastructures for the bioeconomy and contribute to strengthening RISE’s capabilities in scale-up, testing and demonstration. You will work with a wide variety of concepts and value chains in an international and dynamic environment, with colleagues representing many different nationalities. At RISE, we like different things and we are convinced that diversity contributes to an innovative environment where we together challenge boundaries and develop new knowledge and skills for the future.
Welcome with your application! If this sounds exciting and you want to know more, please contact Johan Börjesson, Director of Innovation Systems, johan.borjesson@ri.se, +46 738 032 315. The application deadline is December 2. Selection and interviews will take place continuously during and after the application period. Apply with CV and questionnaire (no cover letter needed).

Department of Soil and Environment
A 2-month research assistant position is available in the Soil and Environmental Physics group at the Department of Soil and Environment, Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU), in Uppsala. We are looking for a researcher with interest in vegetation-atmosphere interactions, in particular using eddy-covariance data. We offer a stimulating research environment with opportunities to collaborate with soil scientists and ecologists, within SLU, in Sweden and internationally).
About the position
As a research assistant in the project, you will be expected to drive independent research, including data collection from online databases and statistical data analyses, writing scientific papers in collaboration with the project group and external collaborators, and presenting research results at seminars and conferences.
Your profile
We are seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher with excellent skills and experience in collection, harmonization, and statistical analysis of eddy covariance data on carbon fluxes. We are particularly interested in candidates able to link eddy covariance data to remote sensing products.
Given the nature of the research project, we expect the selected candidate to be able to interact with soil scientists, ecologists, and biogeochemists. Experience in publishing in highly ranked scientific journals in English is also important.
About us
The Department of Soil and Environment is a leading soil research institution, both nationally and internationally. Our research focuses on fundamental soil properties and processes, as well as how soil functions are affected by changes in environmental conditions, including climate change. Through research, environmental analysis and education, we contribute knowledge about future sustainable land use and develop new solutions as a basis for decision-making in agriculture, forestry and the urban environment. The working environment at the department is international and we have around 100 employees.
Our research is carried out in seven subject groups with a focus on Soil Biology, Soil Nutrient Cycling, Soil Chemistry, Agricultural Water Management, Soil and Environmental Physics, Soil Mechanics and Soil Management, and the Biogeochemistry of Forest Soils. We are responsible for important research infrastructure in the form of soil chemistry and soil physics laboratories, an X-ray scanner, long-term field experiments, a lysimeter facility, and the field research stations at Lanna and Lövsta. The Department participates in approximately 30 courses at undergraduate and advanced level.
We are a part of the Soil, Water and Environment Center at SLU (MVM-center), which provides links to research on water systems, recycling and bioenergy. Our work is aligned to national environmental and climate goals as well as to the Sustainable Development Goals. We are situated at Campus Ultuna in Uppsala and in Skara. Read more about the department here (https://www.slu.se/en/departments/soil-environment/).
Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

jobs.description:
At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. 
And we need people like you to make it happen.
We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.
Job Summary
 Start your career development and become Tetra Pak’s next Future Talent! We are looking for highly motivated newly graduates to join us in 2027! 
 
 
Future Talent Programme is a Trainee Programme within Tetra Pak. We offer a permanent position from start in September 2027 at our site in Lund. You will onboard an individually designed development programme for 18 months connected to a specific position and the Tetra Pak organization. During the programme you will participate in trainings and job rotations throughout various parts of Tetra Pak to explore your potential and grow as a person. As a Trainee here with us, you will get to know our entire business and collaborate with colleagues all over the world. And this is just the beginning of your Tetra Pak career!
 
In Lamination & Web Handling, we develop and support converting equipment that enables the production of today’s and tomorrow’s packaging materials. Our work focuses on coating processes, including extrusion coating, with a strong emphasis on sustainability. You will be part of this organisation throughout the programme and, on completion, work as a Development Engineer in one of our agile teams.
 
Visit https://www.tetrapak.com/about-tetra-pak/careers/future-talent and read more about Tetra Pak Future Talent Programme!
 
This position belongs to the Leadership Track.
 
You will be based in Lund, Sweden but you will work in a global arena.
What you will do
As our new Future Talent – Lamination & Web handling you will:

Collaborate with fellow engineers in an agile team to develop and maintain converting equipment and processes.
Help ensure production solutions meet the requirements of the new packaging materials we develop.
Share your knowledge to support internal and external stakeholders.
Partner with suppliers and colleagues in other organisations to exchange knowledge and apply it where it makes a difference.
Support our converting factories by applying engineering knowledge to achieve efficient, high-quality production.

We believe you have
A Master’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Engineering Physics (Graduated 2026-2027)
Experience in the processing industry or equipment development is welcome, but not required.
An interest in materials and material processing.
An analytical approach and good problem-solving skills.
An ability to understand and apply engineering solutions.
You are fluent in English, written and spoken.
Good written and spoken communication skills.
International study or experience is an advantage, but not a requirement.

We Offer You
A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape
A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results
An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion
Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements

 
Apply Now
If you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what’s good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at https://jobs.tetrapak.com/. 
This job posting expires on 2026-12-01.

Logent provides contract logistics, transport management, customs services and related solutions across the Nordics and Europe. Sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations, creating long-term value for customers, employees, society and the environment.
The Role:
We are looking for a business-oriented Sustainability Manager to lead and develop Logent’s Group-wide sustainability agenda.
You will drive strategy, compliance, ESG reporting and continuous improvement, working with management, operations, HR, Finance, Procurement and customers to embed sustainability in decisions and daily operations.
As the Group’s sustainability expert, you will translate requirements into practical actions and measurable environmental, social and governance outcomes.
Key Responsibilities:
Sustainability Strategy & Governance:
· Develop and implement the sustainability strategy and roadmap; monitor progress, risks and deviations across the Group.
· Develop and maintain sustainability policies, guidelines and procedures, and support their implementation.
· Translate objectives into business-unit action plans and KPIs.
· Advise executive management and the Board on sustainability.
· Coordinate governance processes and quarterly performance reviews.
ESG Reporting & Compliance:
· Lead sustainability reporting under CSRD, ESRS and other applicable regulations.
· Manage double materiality assessments, ESG data collection and internal controls.
· Coordinate external assurance and auditor reviews.
· Monitor sustainability legislation and ensure ongoing compliance.
· Assess sustainability risks and opportunities and integrate them into business planning.
Climate & Environmental Management:
· Drive emissions reduction programmes and SBTi target implementation.
· Oversee Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reporting and improvements.
· Support energy efficiency, waste management and resource optimisation.
· Work with operations to develop sustainable logistics solutions and customer offerings.
Social & Employee Sustainability:
· Support health and safety, employee engagement, diversity and inclusion initiatives.
· Partner with HR on sustainability training and awareness.
· Promote a strong sustainability culture across the organisation.
Supply Chain & Customer Engagement:
· Identify business opportunities through sustainable logistics solutions.
· Support customer development, sustainability requests, questionnaires and tenders.
· Drive supplier sustainability assessments and responsible sourcing.
Data, Performance & Continuous Improvement:
· Develop sustainability KPIs, dashboards and performance reports.
· Ensure high-quality sustainability data across business units.
· Identify improvements and support sustainability project delivery.
Qualifications:
· Degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Business Administration, Engineering or a related field.
· 3+ years’ experience in sustainability, ESG, environmental management or a related discipline.
· Strong knowledge of CSRD, ESRS, EU Taxonomy, GHG Protocol and relevant ESG frameworks.
· Experience in change management and turning complex requirements into practical business actions.
· Experience in sustainability reporting and ESG data management.
· Experience working across functions in a multi-site organisation.
· Excellent communication and project management skills.
· Fluent English, written and spoken.
Preferred Qualifications:
· Experience in logistics, transport, supply chain or industry.
· Experience with the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi).
· Knowledge of ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and sustainability assurance.
· Experience managing sustainability audits and customer assessments.
Personal Qualities:
· Strategic and analytical, with a hands-on approach.
· Structured, proactive and results-driven.
· Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to influence change.
· Committed to sustainability and business value creation.
What We Offer:
· The opportunity to shape sustainability in a growing international logistics group.
· A visible role with direct access to senior management.
· A collaborative, entrepreneurial culture.
· The chance to deliver environmental and social impact while supporting business growth.
Location: Stockholm (or other Nordic location) Reporting to: CFO Employment Type: Full-time

We are convinced that HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) technology, enabling efficient transmission of electricity at high voltages, is a long-term sustainable solution. The technology is used to transmit energy over long distances and connect electricity networks with minimal losses. In addition to efficient power transmission, HVDC technology helps improve power quality and contributes to the stability of connected power grids. For offshore wind power and long-distance underwater transmission, HVDC is the only realistic alternative.
In this role as a Software Engineer at Hitachi Energy, you will be part of a global HVDC Control & Protection Software team. Our team is responsible for Converter Control and works closely with other domains within Control & Protection, IT/OT, Hardware, and Operations.
As the demand for our technology continues to grow, we are looking for both newly graduated engineers and experienced professionals who are eager to develop their skills and contribute to the future of sustainable energy solutions.
How You'll Make an Impact
Design and develop control functions and software solutions for HVDC Control & Protection systems.
Translate system and customer requirements into reliable engineering solutions.
Participate in design, testing, integration, verification, deployment, and maintenance activities.
Collaborate with teams across Control & Protection, Hardware, IT/OT, and Operations.
Support troubleshooting, testing, and commissioning activities.
Contribute to technical discussions and continuous improvements of methods and tools.
Prepare technical documentation and support customer training activities.
Help ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operation of HVDC systems.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Computer Engineering, Control Systems, Power Systems, or a related field.
Experience working with automation, control systems, power systems, industrial software, or similar technical areas.
Knowledge of PLCs, Industrial Control Systems, protection systems, or substation automation is beneficial.
Experience with industrial communication protocols such as EtherCAT, ModBus, or similar technologies is an advantage.
Experience with DevOps tools, preferably Azure DevOps, is considered a plus.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
